shortDescription: NetApp AWS Cloud Volumes Service Manage Pools.

options.name: api_key
options.description: The access key to authenticate with the AWSCVS Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the AWSCVS Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: feature_flags
options.description: Enable or disable a new feature. This can be used to enable an experimental feature or disable a new feature that breaks backward compatibility. Supported keys and values are subject to change without notice.  Unknown keys are ignored. trace_apis can be set to true to enable tracing, data is written to /tmp/um_apis.log.

options.name: from_name
options.description: rename the existing pool name ( The human readable name of the Pool ) I(from_name) is the existing name, and I(name) the new name can be used with update operation

options.name: name
options.description: pool name ( The human readable name of the Pool ) name can be used for create, update and delete operations

options.name: region
options.description: The region to which the Pool is associated.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: The secret_key to authenticate with the AWSCVS Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: serviceLevel
options.description: The service level of the Pool can be used with pool create, update operations

options.name: sizeInBytes
options.description: Size of the Pool in bytes can be used with pool create, update operations minimum value is 4000000000000 bytes

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified pool should exist or not.

options.name: vendorID
options.description: A vendor ID for the Pool. E.g. an ID allocated by a vendor service for the Pool. can be used with pool create, update operations must be unique
